# PRD: Checkers Game (smoke fixture)

## Summary
Build a minimal web checkers game for two players on one device.

## Goals
- 8x8 board with standard checkers rules
- Turn-based move validation
- Win detection when opponent has no legal moves

## Non-goals
- Online multiplayer
- AI opponent

## Acceptance criteria
1. User can start a new game from a landing page.
2. Illegal moves are rejected with inline feedback.
3. Game ends with a clear winner message.
